downloadSection.title: Download DiDi China and switch to English
items: Open the official DiDi China: Ride Hailing listing for your phone below. Its publisher describes an English interface and international mobile-number login for visitors to China. Check availability and compatibility in your own store before travelling.
Register with a number that you can access for any verification requested. Select its country or region code carefully and follow the number format shown on the registration screen.

The Shanghai government guide shows this language route: 我的 (Me) → 设置 (Settings) → 通用 (General) → Language 语言 → English → Confirm. Use it when those controls appear; the app and mini-program menus can differ by version.

problemSection.title: If DiDi setup fails before your first ride

rows: The store listing will not install
Read the store’s region, account or device-compatibility message. Confirm you opened the DiDi China listing linked above.
Check whether DiDi opens in your already-prepared Alipay or WeChat account; those routes can still require their own verification.
Check the selected country code, number, access to that phone line and the resend instructions shown by the app.
Use official in-app help where available. Keep an official taxi or public-transport option ready rather than relying on an unfinished registration.
Check the language path above and the route you opened: standalone app, Alipay or WeChat. Look for 语言 when the menu is Chinese.
Use available in-app help; save your destination and pickup point in Chinese even when the interface is English.

items: A downloaded app or successful login is only the setup step. Before requesting a car, confirm the destination, pickup point and payment choice in the booking route you will actually use.

downloadFaq.question: Which DiDi app should I download for mainland China?
downloadFaq.answer: Use the official DiDi China: Ride Hailing listing linked in this guide for iPhone or Android. The publisher describes mainland-China service, an English interface and global mobile-number login. Check the listing in your own store for availability and device compatibility before travel.

foreignNumberFaq.question: Can I register for DiDi with a foreign phone number?
foreignNumberFaq.answer: The official DiDi China listings advertise global mobile-number login. Select your country or region code and keep access to that phone line for any verification requested. If a code does not arrive, check the displayed format and resend instructions, then use official help rather than assuming registration is guaranteed.

englishFaq.question: How do I change DiDi to English?
englishFaq.answer: The Shanghai government guide shows Me (我的) → Settings (设置) → General (通用) → Language (语言) → English → Confirm. Follow this path when the same controls appear. Menus can vary between app versions and Alipay or WeChat routes; the DiDi China listings advertise an English interface.
